description: Ministry of Megapolis and Western Development - Order made to declare that all the areas of lands comprising of Ambalantota Pradeshiya Sabha Area situated in Hambantota District to be an Urban Development Area
reasoning: This gazette notification declares a specific land area (Ambalantota Pradeshiya Sabha) to be an Urban Development Area under the Urban Development Authority Law. The content focuses entirely on land development matters, including detailed metes and bounds descriptions of the area, references to previous land declarations, and specifications of boundaries with adjacent divisions. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of declaring land for development, making it a Land Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
